[[File:Sheldon.png|thumb|250px|Sheldon]] '''Sheldon''' (Japanese: '''マネージャー''' ''Manager'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|OS}} episode ''[[EP108|Pokémon Double Trouble]]''. Sheldon is [[Luana]]'s assistant and also her hotel manager. {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} first met him upon Luana's return to her hotel, instructing him to give the kids a deluxe suite to settle into; he readily agreed. Later, he acted as the judge between Luana and Ash's battle for the {{Badge|Jade Star}}. When the gang were preparing to leave [[Kumquat Island]], Sheldon was there to see them off, along with Luana and the hotel staff. In true manager fashion, his parting words were less parting and more indicative of their hotel service. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{normal color}}|bordercolor={{normal color light}} |ja=坂口候一 ''[[Kōichi Sakaguchi]]'' |en=[[Eric Stuart]] |ar=فادي الرفاعي ''Fadi Rifai'' |fr_eu=Jean-Marc Delhausse |it=Massimo di Benedetto |pl=Krzysztof Zakrzewski |es_eu=Antonio Miguel Fernández Ramos}} ==Trivia== * Sheldon is the very first person to [[Battle judge|judge]] one of Ash's [[Gym]] battles in {{aniseries|PTS}}.
